props.gloss_en: the mishna: one does all the needs of circumcision on Shabbat -- one circumcises, uncovers, sucks, and places a bandage and cumin on it
'all the needs of circumcision' comes to include what the Rabbis taught: the circumciser, while still engaged, returns [even for shreds that do not invalidate]
the baraita: the circumciser, as long as he is engaged in the circumcision, returns both for shreds that invalidate the circumcision and for shreds that do not
the baraita: once he withdrew -- for shreds that invalidate the circumcision, he returns
the baraita: [once he withdrew,] for shreds that do not invalidate the circumcision, he does not return
who is the tanna of 'withdrew, does not return'? R' Yochanan: it is R' Yishmael son of R' Yochanan ben Beroka
the baraita: a fourteenth that falls on Shabbat -- one flays the Paschal lamb up to the breast; the words of R' Yishmael son of R' Yochanan ben Beroka
the Sages: one flays all of it

the baraita: 'this is my God and I will beautify Him' -- beautify yourself before Him in mitzvot: make before Him a beautiful sukka, lulav, shofar, tzitzit, Torah scroll, written for His name in beautiful ink with a beautiful quill by an expert scribe, wrapped in beautiful silks
Abba Shaul: 've'anvehu' -- be like Him: as He is gracious and merciful, so you be gracious and merciful
rather, Rav Ashi: whose is this? it is R' Yosei
the mishna: whether [the new moon] was clearly seen or not clearly seen, they desecrate Shabbat for it
R' Yosei: if it was clearly seen, they do not desecrate Shabbat for it
rather, the Nehardeans: it is the Rabbis who dispute R' Yosei

the mishna: four priests enter [with the new showbread and frankincense], four precede them [to remove the old]; these slide and these place, the handbreadth of this one beside the handbreadth of that one, because it says 'before Me continually' (Ex 25:30)
R' Yosei: even if these take [the old bread off] and [then] these place [the new] -- this too was 'continually'
the baraita: one completes the cutting of the circumcision
the baraita: and if he did not complete the cut -- he is punishable by karet
who [is punishable]? Rav Kahana: the craftsman [the circumciser]
rather, Rav Pappa: an adult
Rav Ashi: of an adult it is written explicitly: 'and an uncircumcised male who will not circumcise [the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off]' (Gen 17:14)

Rav Ashi: actually the craftsman -- where he came at twilight of Shabbat, they told him 'you will not manage', he said 'I will manage', he did it and did not manage; it turns out he made a wound, and he is punishable by karet

objections.gloss_en: ממאי? דילמא עד כאן לא קאמר רבי ישמעאל... התם -- משום דלא בעינן זה אלי ואנוהו, אבל הכא דבעינן זה אלי ואנוהו -- הכי נמי (and דתניא: זה אלי ואנוהו, התנאה לפניו במצות)
